meta.title: perf: optimize spring bone animation processing
meta.body_summary: Optimize spring bone animation processing in Blender VRM add-on by caching bone name and extension lookups, reducing redundant matrix operations, and micro-adjusting angle thresholds; includes cProfile benchmarks showing ~2.3% runtime improvement.

perf_labels.notes: Devin provided cProfile benchmarks showing ~2.3% improvement; PR closed after ~1.4h with archived bot, no human review.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 277 changed lines across 5 files, this is a small-to-medium edit by absolute volume. As a performance PR with benchmark evidence, it was closed without merge due to lack of review engagement and bot archival.

review_details.concern_detail: No formal review or human comments were recorded in the dataset.
review_details.performance_claim: Reduced spring bone animation processing time by ~2.3% (from 2.600s to 2.539s) and function calls by 2.0% via caching and redundant operation elimination.
review_details.rejection_signals: PR closed after ~1.4 hours; Devin bot was archived stating 'Devin is archived and cannot be woken up.'; maintainer closed branch with no further comments.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: PR targeted a niche Blender add-on performance optimization with detailed benchmarks, but no human review engagement occurred; Devin session was archived shortly after creation, halting any collaboration.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: Benchmark before/after text files were attached, but PR closed before any human validation; no automated CI performance test visible.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without merge; no regression was observed as the change never landed.

core_change_summary.description: In handler.py, refactored calculate_joint_pair_head_pose_bone_rotations to reduce redundant matrix transformations and reuse normalized vectors. Added early return and invalid-name caching to get_bone_name in property_group.py. Added caching to get_bone_extension in extension.py. Micro-adjusted angle threshold in update_pose_bone_rotations. Added benchmark text files.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Benchmark text files added for documentation; contain cProfile output.
